site.announcement: A little romance, a little ink, and a lifetime of stories
site.heroEyebrow: ROMANCE, WRITTEN LIKE A LOVE LETTER
site.heroText: For the stories we carry, the words we never said, and the love that stays long after the final page.
site.heroSideNote: Some love stories never truly leave us.
site.quote: The most beautiful stories are the ones we carry in our hearts long after the last page.
site.heroImageAlt: Original romantic still-life artwork with vintage books, a handwritten journal, candlelight and flowers

book.eyebrow: FROM THE WRITING DESK · THE DEBUT NOVEL
book.title: The Quiet Between Us
book.subtitle: A love story about everything left unsaid.
book.genre: Contemporary romance · Football · Emotional second chances
book.description: Cole Hayes and Lila Bennett know what it means to love each other. But somewhere between the noise of the world and the words they couldn't say, they lost the way back. This is a story about the distance love can survive—and the courage it takes to finally be heard.
book.note: A first look at the story. Final book description and release details to come.

about.heading: A letter from me to you.
about.paragraphOne: I'm a Central Texas author, wife, and mother of three, with one big, fluffy dog named Daisy who has never met a moment she didn't want to be part of.
about.paragraphTwo: I write love stories about imperfect people, deep feelings, and the sometimes messy, always meaningful journey toward finding one another again.
about.paragraphThree: If you love a story that stays with you long after the last page, I hope you'll feel right at home here.
about.portraitCaption: A little glimpse behind the pages

newsletter.heading: A letter, just for you.
newsletter.description: A little note for the romantics: book news, behind-the-scenes moments, and occasional glimpses of the stories taking shape on my desk.
newsletter.consentText: I'd like to receive occasional book and author updates by email.
newsletter.note: This is an early-interest list. Newsletter emails will begin after an email service is connected.

contact.heading: Leave me a little note.
contact.description: A note from a reader, a question, or a collaboration idea? You can leave a message right here.
